title: Lisbon in my pocket (example)

casa.name: Casa do Exemplo (invented)
casa.note: This hotel does not exist: it shows where the check-in notes go. **Bold** works here too.

days.title: Baixa and Alfama on foot
reminders: This is an invented trip, here to show what the app does. Times and descriptions are examples: check everything before a real visit.

stops.title: Praça do Comércio
stops.text: Start at the big square on the river, then walk under the arch into Rua Augusta.

stops.title: Lisbon Cathedral
stops.text: Ten minutes uphill. The tram line passes right in front of the door.

stops.title: Miradouro de Santa Luzia
stops.text: A terrace over the roofs of Alfama. A good place for a break.

stops.title: Castelo de São Jorge
stops.text: The castle on top of the hill. Tickets are sold at the gate.

stops.title: Lunch in Alfama
stops.text: No coordinates on this stop: it has no pin on the map, and that is fine.

stops.title: Miradouro da Senhora do Monte
stops.text: The highest viewpoint in the centre, best at sunset.

days.note: If it rains: swap this day with the next one. **Belém** has more places indoors.

stops.title: Mosteiro dos Jerónimos
stops.text: Go early: the queue grows during the morning.

stops.title: Pastéis de Belém
stops.text: The custard tarts, still warm. The queue for take-away moves fast.

stops.title: Torre de Belém
stops.text: A walk along the river to the tower.

stops.title: MAAT
stops.text: You can walk on the roof of the museum for free.

stops.title: LX Factory
stops.text: Shops and cafés in an old factory, under the bridge.

days.title: A day out of town
reminders: A day with two alternative plans: pick one with the buttons below. The app remembers the choice.

stops.title: Train from Rossio
stops.text: About 40 minutes. This stop has no coordinates on purpose.

stops.title: Sintra station
stops.text: From here a bus climbs to the palaces.

stops.title: Palácio da Pena
stops.text: The coloured palace on top of the hill.

stops.title: Quinta da Regaleira
stops.text: Gardens, tunnels and the spiral well.

stops.title: Sintra old town
stops.text: A coffee and a pastry before the train back.

stops.title: Cascais station
stops.text: Train along the coast from Cais do Sodré.

stops.title: Praia da Rainha
stops.text: A small beach between the rocks, two minutes from the station.

stops.title: Boca do Inferno
stops.text: A walk along the cliff to the sea arch.

rows.label: Card
rows.text: One rechargeable card works on metro, trams, buses and trains.

rows.label: Trams
rows.text: The historic trams are crowded: board at the first stop.

infoNote: Everything in this example is invented or approximate. Load your own trip file from «Trips».
